english.note: Use 碟 as the all-purpose word for an individual eating plate or a plateful of food.

exampleSentences.english: This plate of food smells great.

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical plate, and in context it can also mean one plateful or serving.

exampleSentences.english: This dish is holding some vegetables.
